verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official CLI for developing Slack apps (docs.slack.dev/tools/slack-cli), with commands like `slack create` for scaffolding Bolt projects, plus a documented download/tool selection flow, and it fits within Slack's broader agentic/AI ecosystem (MCP server, events API). Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews of the CLI itself and more detail on CLI command coverage/versioning.
